title: Broader range of intensifiers (such as too, enough) - Degree modifiers expansion

options.answer: The coffee is tooo much hot.
The coffee is very too hot.

explanation.en: 'Too' is used before adjectives without additional modifiers like 'much' or 'very'.
explanation.ru: 'Too' используется перед прилагательными без дополнительных модификаторов, таких как 'much' или 'very'.
explanation.uz: 'Too' qo'shimcha modifikatorlar ('much' yoki 'very') ishlatmasdan sifatlar oldida ishlatiladi.

options.answer: She is enough tall to reach the shelf.
She is tall enough to reach the shelf.
She is very enough tall to reach the shelf.

explanation.en: 'Enough' comes after adjectives: adjective + enough + to-infinitive.
explanation.ru: 'Enough' стоит после прилагательных: прилагательное + enough + инфинитив с to.
explanation.uz: 'Enough' sifatlardan keyin keladi: sifat + enough + to infinitiv.

options.answer: The movie was quite much interesting.
The movie was very quite interesting.

explanation.en: 'Quite' is used directly before adjectives without additional intensifiers.
explanation.ru: 'Quite' используется непосредственно перед прилагательными без дополнительных усилителей.
explanation.uz: 'Quite' qo'shimcha kuchaytiruvchilarsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sifatlar oldida ishlatiladi.

explanation.en: 'Rather' modifies adverbs directly without additional words.
explanation.ru: 'Rather' модифицирует наречия напрямую без дополнительных слов.
explanation.uz: 'Rather' qo'shimcha so'zlarsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ravishlarni o'zgartiradi.

options.answer: The room is very extremely cold.
The room is extremely much cold.

explanation.en: 'Extremely' is used directly before adjectives to show very high degree.
explanation.ru: 'Extremely' используется непосредственно перед прилагательными для обозначения очень высокой степени.
explanation.uz: 'Extremely' juda yuqori darajani ko'rsatish uchun to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sifatlar oldida ishlatiladi.

options.answer: She is fairly good at tennis.
She is fairly much good at tennis.
She is very fairly good at tennis.

explanation.en: 'Fairly' modifies adjectives directly to express moderate degree.
explanation.ru: 'Fairly' модифицирует прилагательные напрямую для выражения умеренной степени.
explanation.uz: 'Fairly' o'rtacha darajani ifodalash uchun sifatlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'zgartiradi.

options.answer: The test was incredibly much difficult.
The test was too very incredibly difficult.

explanation.en: 'Incredibly' is an intensifier that comes directly before adjectives.
explanation.ru: 'Incredibly' - это усилитель, который стоит непосредственно перед прилагательными.
explanation.uz: 'Incredibly' to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sifatlar oldida keladigan kuchaytiruvchidir.

explanation.en: 'Remarkably' modifies adverbs directly to show exceptional degree.
explanation.ru: 'Remarkably' модифицирует наречия напрямую для обозначения исключительной степени.
explanation.uz: 'Remarkably' alohida darajani ko'rsatish uchun ravishlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'zgartiradi.

options.answer: The weather is absolutely much perfect.
The weather is very absolutely perfect.

explanation.en: 'Absolutely' is used with extreme or absolute adjectives without additional modifiers.
explanation.ru: 'Absolutely' используется с экстремальными или абсолютными прилагательными без дополнительных модификаторов.
explanation.uz: 'Absolutely' qo'shimcha modifikatorlarsiz ekstremal yoki mutlaq sifatlar bilan ishlatiladi.

options.answer: The book is somewhat much boring.
The book is very somewhat boring.

explanation.en: 'Somewhat' expresses a moderate degree and modifies adjectives directly.
explanation.ru: 'Somewhat' выражает умеренную степень и модифицирует прилагательные напрямую.
explanation.uz: 'Somewhat' o'rtacha darajani ifodalaydi va sifatlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'zgartiradi.

explanation.uz: Bu parcha kuchaytiruvchilarning kontekstda ishlatilishini tasvirlaydi, 'too' ortiqchani, 'so...that' natijani, 'enough' yetarlilikni qanday ko'rsatishini va boshqa kuchaytiruvchilar sifat va ravishlar darajasini qanday o'zgartirishini ko'rsatadi.
